description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the PlaceholderResolver interface, providing methods to resolve placeholders, retrieve prefix and supported names, and manage placeholder source information.

classes.name: ImmutablePlaceholderResolver
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the PlaceholderResolver interface that manages placeholder resolution and related metadata.

methods.name: ImmutablePlaceholderResolver
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the resolver with a given placeholder and optional source.

methods.name: getPlaceholderSource
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the placeholder source if available.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a placeholder name given a placeholder source, delegating to the wrapped placeholder.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Retrieves the prefix associated with the placeholder.

methods.name: getSupportedNames
methods.description: Returns the list of supported placeholder names.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if a given placeholder name is supported.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality based on placeholder and placeholderSource.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on placeholder and placeholderSource.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the resolver.
